source: Headlines the site published (data.json news and newsIntraday in the data commits), paired within one 08:00 KST cycle.
definition: SAME = both headlines report the same occurrence as their main subject: same actor, same action, same day or session, and for a market wrap the same market. NOT SAME = shared backdrop only: another asset class or region reacting to the same trigger, a market wrap against the report of the event it cites, a preview or analysis against the report, a later or earlier moment described in the opposite direction.
labeledBy: Fable, 2026-11-27. One labeler; the first window was labeled before any threshold was changed, the second was not used to choose one.
sampling: Every pair of a cycle is put in a stratum by the rule at sampling time; each stratum is sampled with a fixed seed and weighted back to its population.
